players.bio: Elías Calderón (born 4 February 2001) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a defender for Chilean Primera División club Deportes Copiapó on loan from Belgrano.

Ezequiel Matías Muñoz (born 8 October 1990) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a centre-back for Argentine club Lanús. His nickname is Il niño di Pergamino or El Chiquito. Club career At 18 years of age, Muñoz made his league debut with Boca Juniors during a 0–1 defeat to Estudiantes de La Plata during the 2009 Clausura tournament.

Facundo Valentín Lencioni (born 14 February 2001) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or winger for Gimnasia Mendoza. Lencioni came through the youth setup at Belgrano and made his debut on 25 April 2021 against Nueva Chicago in the Primera Nacional.

Juan José Franco Arrellaga (born 10 February 1992 in Asunción, Paraguay) is a Paraguayan footballer who plays as a midfielder. He plays as a midfielder and his current team is Instituto in the Argentine First Division.
Martín Matías Ezequiel Vargas (born 8 May 1997), nicknamed Monito (in English: "Little Monkey") is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Chinese club Shanghai Port.

Santiago Rodríguez (born August 23, 1997; Arizona, San Luis, Argentina) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a midfielder. He plays as a striker and his current team is Sarmiento de Junín of the Argentine First Division.

Ulises Benjamín Sánchez Scotta (born 26 June 1998), commonly known as Ulises Sánchez, is an Argentine footballer who plays as a midfielder. He plays as a midfielder and his current team is Club Atlético Belgrano of the Argentine First Division.
